name: trident
description: Unofficial Tripo 3D API plugin. Generate, texture, retopologize, rig, animate and convert 3D models: text/image/multiview to 3D, P1/P2 low-poly, Smart UV, segmentation, Gaussian splats, with a workflow skill that prices plans before spending credits.

tripo_api_key.title: Tripo API key
tripo_api_key.description: Key from https://platform.tripo3d.ai (starts with tsk_), stored in your system keychain. Leave empty to use TRIPO_API_KEY from your environment.

output_dir.title: Output directory
output_dir.description: Where generated meshes, images and splats are saved, one folder per task.

base_url.title: Tripo API host
base_url.description: Leave as is for global keys. China-region keys need https://openapi.tripo3d.com/v3.
